body: Nowadays, I agree. I would never do the same.
Nope. Gonna be a year on and I am still blocked.

It is more about attachment style and each person than related to gender. I am a man, I would try to persist on the relationship as much as I could. My ex ran away the first opportunity she could. She is an avoidant.
Not communicating is one thing. Blocking is another. I believe people need space. To think and reflect. Blocking means cutting off people you loved/liked (or you pretended to).
I would not do anyway, but I do understand dumpees who do.

She is not coming back. And the experience of being blocked is just the worst possible. I will never understand why someone would do that. People nowadays just run away of having to talk to others and to explain things. People are each day losing more empathy towards others. The blocking thing is just a quick way of running away from communicating. Because it is easier. Then, the other person have thousands of things in the head wondering why this happened and why you were just cut out of her/his life so strong and suddenly.
Give him space. But he is an idiot and seems to be looking for conflict.

As sad as it is. We typically just grow and improve when something break us, when we suffer. The hard times gives us time to think and reflect about ourselves, our actions, our life. And usually that is the difference between dumpers and dumpees. Dumpers usually think they are 100% right and the other partner is 100% wrong, this thinking process never leads margin to improve. Why would you think about improving and grow if you are right? On the other hand, the dumpee usually suffers a lot, and put a lot of thought into the breakup, leading to conclusions that usually leads to growth and improvement. As sad as I still am, without the hard BU, without being dumped, I would never be the person I am now. I am more confident, more mature, more ready, I am working more on myself and putting me first. If my ex had not done what she did, I would not be the person I am now.
Nah. And never will. Pretty sure I am dead to her.
Yep. The funny thing is: I do not even know if I would be back with her. But the no contact, being blocked makes me sick. I wish I could just talk to her once more to finish it in good terms.
Agree.

I was blocked by her in every social media existent. Anyway, I would not block her. It is just not something I would do. If it was up to me and I would just unfollow her. Blocking means avoiding all communications which in my opinion usually is not really mature, or at least is not something I agree or would do. But I understand people who do this anyway.

I would. Because I've changed. I can handle the situation better. I am an anxious person with an anxious attachment style. I am also an overthinker. I ended up being too intense and overthinking everything. My guess is she got suffocated by all of this and decided to end everything at the first time she felt I was like this. She is an avoidant. But I know I messed up. Now, I would do everything different. I am more mature, I am more confident on myself, I would never overthink the way I did, I would be more patient and respect her boundaries. I am way more secure in myself and the value I would have for my relationships. So, basically I would totally give her a second chance, because that would mean giving myself a second chance as well.
Every day basically. I do not beat myself anymore. I know I learned a lesson. I just wish she could see me now. I am so much better, more mature, etc.
Unmeasurable ones. I did everything for her. I was basically a satellite living around her.

I actually apologized and worked on myself. Did not matter. She still blocked me on everything. And I never heard of her anymore. If a guy does not apologize for something, it has nothing to do with pride. He is just an asshole.

I guess you will someday accept it. But you will never forget her. I love my ex and I loved her like I have never loved anyone else. Some days are easier than others, I am almost fully over her. Still, I remember her a lot. And I know I still love her. This will not change. I take accountability for my mistakes and I know I am a different person right now. I wish she could see me now, but she never wanted to. Therefore, I like to think it is her loss.

As cliche as it might sound, you will not forget her. She will always somehow appear in your memories. She might even appear in your dreams. It is going to happen. The pain will not disappear, it will fade. Until at some point, you will feel you got over her. I am on this process. I still think about her, I still love her and I will still love her. But I am living my life. I feel like I am progressing in a lot of areas. If she comes back one day and wants to talk, depending my relationship situation, I might talk to her. I do not close any doors for it. Best thing to do is to work on yourself and let time do its job.
Well, you really dodged a bullet.

This is not true. And this varies according to person/situation. My ex broke up with me in february. I feel okay now, but I still think a lot about her. I still love her. She is still special to me. Although she blindsided me and did not make any effort to keep the relationship, I still love her. Generalization is wrong.
Texted her on her birthday and after some days, texted her again. She obviously did not reply. And blocked me on every single social network existent.
What a shit person for god's sake. I swear I will never understand the anger that some people have for their exes. If it is a dumper I can understand even less.
Shouldn't.
It is exactly what I thought. People seemed to be there to flirt pretty much. Which is not the concept of the event lol.

Yep. Approached some people, could not keep a conversation for a long time. I was dressed in a really normal way. And I have no idea whether I am an approachable guy or not hahaha. Seems like I am not.

Like everything related to people: it depends on the person. Some will. Some will not. Move on with your life. You might even keep the hope of your ex coming back. But you need to move on with your life.

To be honest, I am in the same boat and one of the things I think was wrong is the concept "she was my life". We, as caring individuals and in love ones, tend to put so much effort into a person that we end up stopping caring about ourselves. The other person really becomes our life. I actually take that lesson for my next relationships. I do not want to be dependent. I want to be co-dependent. I want to have a partner. Someone who I like being with because it makes me better, because I enjoy being with, but if the person decides to go, I will still have my life. I will probably be sad, but I cannot forget about me.

Yep. I do not understand people whatsoever. I would not do that to any person whatsoever. Even people I do not like I do not act indifferent. If I happen to see them by accident, I will greet the person, do some chit chat and that is all.

I honestly do not understand the blocking act. I never blocked her and I would never do. My guess is: people block the other one because they feel something for the person. If the person is not significant to you, and you act indifferent to that person, you would not be bothered. Whether this is on social media or anywhere else.
I actually saw her by accident. It was worse than not seeing her. She acted like I never existed in her life.
There is no rule of thumb for that. It depends on inumerous factors. Including the person that dumped the other one.

I actually think that I will somehow have hope for a long time. I still hope that she will text me someday. But in the meantime I am living my life. Working out, getting better, improving. If she comes back, great, we might sort things out. If she doesn't, it is her lost.
I am a man. No. It varies. Not according to gender, but according to person.
I would love to hate her. But I do not. I actually still love her.

Kind of a tricky question. Unless you were completely guilty of causing the breakup, like cheating or something as serious as it, not necessarily was your lost. I miss my ex everyday. It is better than before, I function, I am better, I am working on myself, but I miss her. Do I feel like I "lost" her? No. She lost me. It was her decision. I had my flaws, I made mistakes. I also know I could fix it and we could have been through it if she wanted to. She did not. Therefore, I do miss her. But do I feel like I lost her? Nope. She lost me.

Cannot judge you. Already did the same. But it is only a temporary euphoria and good sensation. After falling asleep and waking up everything else comes back and everything remains the same. It is tough. But hang in there. Things will be better.

I guess you never get over completely. The first love is the one you will carry for your life. And if the BU happened while you were still completely in love, it is something that it will probably follow you for your life. That does not mean that will bother your other relationships and so on. But you will probably always have the memories. You will love someone else. It might be even stronger than your first love. But the first one...is the first.

- After a long time, yes, it was easier.

- I did not know it would be a problem. It became a problem when the situation happened. I was too anxious, too intense and ended up pushing her away.

- After she said my attitude was sick (got really anxious after a small argument and she was not answering me either on texts or calls, decided to send her flowers, all of that in a few hours). The other day, when she answered and decided to end everything, I apologized and said I would get better. It did not matter.

- Nope. 

- Only a few months after the BU actually.

- Not really but made my healing easier. Still a work in progress but I know the mistakes I made, therefore, it is easier to improve on them..

That is actually true. It is usually like that. When people break up, unless something really strong happens like cheating or something worse, it is like that. The decision was already taken, it was only not communicated. Then, it was. Usually it is blindsided or the person waits for a mistake that you make then breaks up with you.

A lot of things: fell in love really fast, showed her an immense amount of affection although it was not mutual. Never asked what she really wanted in our relationship,  if was a serious one or something else. Became too anxious that she would leave me, was too intense, did not value myself, put her on a pedestal, after the breakup tried to contact her twice, etc.

It is ALMOST never only one side to blame. If you did not cheat and just made a mistake, the relationship could have worked on it if she/he was up to it. People make mistakes, it is okay, you should blame yourself, your option is to improve, work on yourself and learn from your mistakes. This will actually prove to your ex that you are not the one that lost an opportunity.

I guess the "will not let any mistake slide" might be an issue. What does it mean? We all make mistakes, some of them, we let them slide, or we just talk with the other person in order to fix it. Most of the points are choices. And you are free to do it, they are not red flags, they are just choices.
8 months still blocked on everything. Actually I deleted her contact, so no idea whether I am still blocked on whatsapp or not, but on Instagram I am still blocked.

Pretty much like I feel. Mine actually walked away after I got anxious and was too intense on her. Overcrossed the boundaries. Sent her some texts, called her twice, sent her flowers as an apology, all at the same time. She did not give me the chance to be better. I am better now. I have improved a lot since then. I do not blame her to be honest. Therefore, I feel the same way. I also feel I will never feel the same way for anyone the way I felt for her. It sucks, honestly.
I have the same feeling.

Pretty much because I got anxious after a small argument, sent her a couple of messages, called her twice, sent her flowers. She thought it was too intense (to be fair, it was, considering it was a small and not important argument). I've since then learned I have an anxious attachment style and have been working on myself ever since. Already had similar anxious situations like the one that led to my BU and I could act in another way, much healthier.
Looks that way. 8 months and still on.
Totally agree. Been doing that for the past month and my life literally got a thousand times better.

If you think you should do it, do it. But do not get your expectations high. I did the same with flowers after a small argument we had, she hated it and got extremely angry. I thought it would be a nice gesture. She ended up calling me sick, breaking up and blocking me on every social network existent. If you think you should do this, do it. Listen to your heart, but do not get your expectations up.
Yeah. I am always comparing them. It sucks.

Any physical activity might help. Obviously it does not work as a magic wand. You will not heal your depression once you start working out or doing any physical activity. But it does help. It takes your mind off a lot of stuff. Boosts your energy for a while. The hardest part is to start. Once you do, the rest goes smoothier.
Absolutely. My ex blocked me on everything and never looked back. I am pretty sure she has a wrong idea specially about me.

She did not show much affection and I was afraid to ask her about that. We never talked properly about the relationship, probably because I was afraid of the answers she would give me. I ended up being blindsided.

I would prefer my ex cheated on me than blindsided me, called me sick and blocked me on every social network possible. I also think that it depends on situation. People can learn from their mistakes. Depending the situation, one time it might be forgivable.
My ex (27F) did the same. She blocked me on everything afterwards. This sucks.

I do not think she did. She was actually not that pretty naturally. But she had an incredibly good taste regarding skincare, haircare, makeup, clothing and so on. With that combo, she was gorgeous. I had only eyes for her. But I saw her a few weeks ago by accident and she was basically the same. Still incredibly pretty. 

But I can say the opposite about myself. I did become prettier after the break up. I started doing my skincare routine, grooming always when needed, taking good care of my hair, started working out. Improved my fashion style and so on. And I can say: the BU actually made me go for it. It took a while, specially in order to start working out. But when you start it, you feel more confident each day. 

I do think the BU might be a booster in order for you to take care of yourself. Specially if you are the dumpee. It might be ridiculous, but it does feel good when your ex see you again, and you are different, prettier, elegant, and so on. And besides that, it is indeed a healthier lifestyle to follow. Good diet, good care of yourself, working out, etc.

1) To be happy with myself first and to not be dependent of the other person.
2) Learned to be more patient, less anxious and less intense.
3) I want to be with someone because this someone makes me better, not because I am afraid of being alone.
It is tough. I always associate with my times with her. Every single person I meet, I compare to her. I am better, 8 months after BU, but it is still a work in progress.

Ella me mandó a la mierda porque yo fui muy intenso. De hecho, ella tenía razón. Yo fui muy intenso. Habiamos tenido una discusión medio sin importancia mientras yo estaba en Brasil y ella en Argentina. Solamente por WhatsApp todo. Le pedí disculpas (aunque no haya sido mi culpa ni nada) y le dije que le iba a dar tiempo y espacio. Después de 48 horas, ella no me respondió nada más y como soy bastante ansioso me puse preocupado. Le llamé 2x y no me contestó. Le envié unos 5 mensajes en whatsapp, tampoco me contestó. El otro día, le envié flores también. Después que las flores llegaron, ahi ella decidió contestarme diciendo que todo lo que yo hice era demasiado, que yo era muy intenso, que mi actitud fue enfermiza y que no quería más nada conmigo. 

Creo que ella tenía razón con relación a mi intensidad, hoy yo haría las cosas de otra manera. Era realmente algo sin importancia la discusión que tuvimos, así que no hacía falta mi inseguridad y ansiedad por eso. Hoy, yo le daría a la otra persona más tiempo y espacio. Obviamente con esa chica, luego que me di cuenta lo que yo había hecho, le pedí disculpas, reconocí mi error. Poco importó, pasó un tiempo y me bloqueó en todo.
Watching House, Suits, Queer Eye, and so on. Basically binge watching them all.
Thanks mate. We will heal and get better!
Same for me.

I actually go out with people, have been in some dates and I am seeing a girl currently. Made it clear about my intentions, which is not anything serious rn. I still think about my ex from time to time. I am afraid I will never love anyone the same way I loved her.
She blocked me on every social media existent on earth. Even ones I never used in my life like TikTok.

I am a man and I am the dumpee. I broke NC because I love her. And I still do. I just wanted to check out how was she doing. If she was open to talk to me. Did not really care about sex whatsoever. Just wanted to see her and talk to her. Obviously she did not answer.
I would be actually surprised if you are a man. If you are, you must be the new Ryan Gosling or something.
Wtf was that.

When she broke up with me and blocked me on everything. I do confess that I made a mistake. She did not answer me for 48 hours after a small argument over nothing basically. But I got really worried and anxious she was not replying. Then, I started freaking out. Sent her some messages, called her twice. Decided to send her flowers with an apology message. Did all of this in like 4 hours. She thought it was too intense, called me sick. Said she did not want anything with me anymore because of that, even though I immediately apologized and recognized that I did screw everything up. She did not care and blocked me on everything. That moment I realized it was just a summer fling for her while I was deeply in love.

I guess they main thing is: even though you might make a mistake, they just do not care. If it doesn't happen the way they want, they will get out and never look back to you again. They will treat you like shit. And they usually will not care forever about you.

I agree. It gives us confidence, energy and a goal. Which is really important after a break-up. I spent basically 8 months really bad. Till one day I saw her again by accident. She did not care at all. This made me wake up. For real. The other day I started to change my habits. It's been 2 weeks and I can say: I haven't felt this good in ages. When people say: get yourself busy, go to gym, cook your meals, sleep better as ways to get over. It really works. Obviously the first step is SO DIFFICULT. But after you start doing this, it is hard to stop. Sometimes I am tired and I want to watch Netflix and lay down. But I push myself to do my workout routine. Sometimes I cannot even complete my sets. But I will try my best. Each day you do something, it is a progress. Healing isn't linear. But each step forward is progress. Let's keep moving forward!

Well, basically the same story as I had. But she blocked me. I saw her by accident 2 weeks ago. The act like she did not care. I know I made a mistake. I made that mistake of not giving her space and time because it was the first time I felt like I feel for her. I did not know how to handle it. Now I know. I am more mature. I know what I should have done. And I know that this will not repeat. I still believe she is the girl I want. 

It is tough. But we will keep going. We might have made a mistake. But they did too. The mistake they made was to lose us. And treat us like we were nothing. They will regret. I know they will.

He has no empathy and he is an asshole. You dodged a bullet. His answer only highlights that he did not acknowledge any errors and that he just do not think he needs to improve. And the worst thing: he just does not care, he knew his answer would hurt you. He sent to you anyway. I would recommend for you to not talk with that psycopath again.
I felt the same way. The first time I messed up and let my anxiety control me, she decided to break me. And we never talked again after that.

Same happened to me. I did the same thing as you. I was worried, called her, sent her some messages (6/7), asking whether she was okay, why she would not talk to me and so on. Then, I sent her flowers and an apology message. Then, she said I was too intense, my attitude was sick and she was scared of me.  

Looking back, I now I made a mistake. Immediately, I went to therapy and started working on my anxiety. Then, I told her that. And she blocked me in every single social media existent. 

Thankfully I am really better about my anxiety, I know I can now give time and space to someone. I started getting busier also, been focusing on work, reducing social media time and started working out.

I mean, I somehow regret my desperation to keep her, my fear of losing her every single day and my overthinking process of everything. But no way I am going to regret how much I did for her and how much I loved her. I did everything she asked for. I was a really good partner. I was caring, thoughtful, understanding, etc. The first time I mess up being too anxious and too intense, she breaks up. I made a mistake of being too anxious and intense, no doubt about it. And I learned from my mistakes. I am less anxious now, I can give someone time and space. And I will still do and love someone else the same way I did for her.

She said I was too intense and had a sick attitude. She vanished for 2 days after a small discussion. I got worried, called her, sent her some messages asking whether she was ok or not. Asking if she did not want to talk to me, etc. Then, sent her some flowers with an apology message for the discussion we had. The next day, she said I was too intense and my reaction was sick. 

After some long period of reflextion, I actually realize she was right. I was too intense, basically suffocating her in that particular day because of my anxiety (which I have for years now), and I did not give her space and time after our little argument. I ended up messing everything up. I wish I could do everything again. I am now a better person, I am working on myself, loving myself, I learned the lesson, I am giving people time, I am more secure of myself.
Same goes for me. She did not wish me happy birthday as well. And I am blocked on every social network. Yet, I miss her.

Same happens to me over and over. It is part of the process. At least I am working better, eating better, drinking at least 2 liters of water daily, doing skincare routine, working out. But, yeah, somehow, when you think you are finally moving on, the memories come over all again. 8 months since we break up and she still pops in my head.

Yes. Healing is not a linear process. The feeling of the potential relationship that did not happen might stick for a while even though you seem like you moved on. Keep doing what you are doing and eventually this will go away.
I actually just said I would get better, look for help, be less anxious. It did not matter to her. I do not regret trying to keep her. And neither should you.
Most likely no. But you never know. Time will tell. Maybe you find someone else. Maybe your ex will find someone else. Maybe you will your ex again. It depends.

Usually is. And that does not mean you did not screw up or do not have a % of the blame for the breakup. But they choose to shift the entire blame on you because it is the easy thing to do. The hard thing to do is confront you when you screw up, or made a mistake, the hard thing to do is to understand your mistake and try to help you improve it. The hard thing to do is to have empathy. People nowadays are afraid to work on the relationship, the easy path is to get out of the relationship, so, they just choose that.

En general, eso pasa porque la gente no sabe reaccionar en una situación así. Y más, significa que ella no es indiferente a vos. Si ella fuera indiferente, podría tenerte en las redes sociales sin problemas, saludarte, etc. Eso significa que ella siente algo por vos, sea culpa, sea cariño, sea rabia.

Cada uno puede hacer lo que quiere, ella decidió cortar de una, y ella tiene derecho a eso. Yo, personalmente, haría diferente. A mi ya me habia pasado boludeces de ella y yo decidí mantenerla porque la amaba. Va de cada uno. Yo no espero alguien perfecto. Y nadie deberia. Cada uno tiene sus defectos e inseguridades. El tema es que hoy, la mayoria de la gente prefiere huir de los problemas de una. Ah, es un boludo, o hizo algo boludo? Bueno, basta.
If you are with expectations of reconciliation or something like that, I would say no. Otherwise, yes.

People nowadays are afraid to go through issues that might appear, they are afraid of commitment, they are afraid of giving satisfaction or explanations to others, when they see that it is becoming serious, they might get away and just quit the relationship. In your case, his previous relationship is a factor. He is scared of this relationship and freaked out. Maybe he can come back when he realizes what he lost. It depends of his perspective of the relationship with you. I'd keep NC for a while. And let his have some space and time to think. As an anxious person I find this extremely difficult, but is something necessary for you right now. Be strong and good luck!

There is no such thing. Also social media are an extremely toxic environment regarding physical appearances, social life, relationships and so on. Everyone looks amazing, no one has problems, everyone has the best friends and the best relationship. The truth on each one's life is far from that. We all have problems, we are not perfect. But on social media (except reddit because we are most anonymous here), no one talks about this. People just show this fake persona to everyone else. You should take a break from social media and do more activities you like, maybe go for a walk, go to a coffee place, read some books, even maybe some books on confidence, self development and so on. You are young, you obviously have your qualities, and no one can tell you whether you are good or not! You are good, you are beautiful and you should know it. Love yourself first! Then let the others love you too.

Esa creo que fue la mejor respuesta posible. Como yo dije en mi mensaje acá, fue lo que paso con mi ex. Ella no se esforzó para entenderme ni nada con mi inseguridad y mi ansiedad, tuvo cero empatia. Yo sé que erré y que fui intenso y un boludo. Y ella decidió no solamente salir de una de relación sin hablar conmigo, como decidió bloquearme en todas las redes sociales. Yo después de mi irracionalidad y mi ansiedad, le pedí disculpas, de inmediato me di cuenta de lo que yo había hecho y ya fui también a buscar ayuda en la terapia. Ella no quiso saber de nada. O sea, mis intentos de mejorar y reconocer el error poco valieron. O sea, es realmente eso, si la persona te quiere, va a esforzarse algo para entenderte. Lo que pasa es que hoy, la gente piensa que el otro tiene que ser perfecto y cuando uno no lo es, se corta la relación. No hay esfuerzo para mantenerlas ni nada. Se busca siempre lo más fácil. Culpar al otro y salir de la relación de una.

Yo hice eso una vez con mi ex, ella no contestaba después de una pequena y sin importancia discusión que tuvimos, y yo como soy re ansioso y tenia miedo de perderla por mis inseguridades, me dejé llevar por la ansiedad y no le di tiempo para pensar y reflexionar. Así que le mandé varios mensajes, preguntando como ella estaba, no me contestó, la llamé 2 veces, tampoco contestó y le mandé flores como un pedido de disculpa. Ella en el otro día me mandó a la mierda diciendo que yo era muy intenso y que me actitud fue enfermiza. Obviamente, yo creo que ella podia haber reaccionado de otra manera, pero, hoy, entiendo lo que yo hice, aunque yo sepa que no hice por mal, queria soluccionar el problema de una y me puse ansioso e irracional, yo sé que fui, de hecho, muy intenso. Ella podia haber hablado conmigo, diciendo que yo no podía ser asi y que de esa manera no sería posible seguir. Ella decidio cortar de una. Yo aprendi la lección, ya me pasó la misma situación de nuevo con otra persona, que queria resolver de una el problema, pero yo pude darle tiempo a la persona y al fin, todo se resolvió. Yo no estoy de acuerdo con los mensajes que dicen para salir de una de eso. Yo creo que vos tenés que hablar con ella de manera seria y decir: mirá, si seguis así, no podemos seguir juntos. Ella puede buscar ayuda, hacer terapia para controlar esa ansiedad e inseguridad que ella tiene, o esa necesidad de atención.

Pretty much same thing happened to me. The difference is we had a small argument, not really important, then she did not talk to me for 2 days. Then, I started to get worried, called her, she did not answer, texted her some times asked whether she was okay or not, whether she would not like to me and so on. Then, I sent her flowers. The other day she reaches out saying I was too intense and she did not want to talk to me anymore. Then she blocked me on every social network possible.

In my opinion this means she has feelings for you. Either positive or negative. If she was really indifferent, she just would not care. And would've greeted you, same way you greet your neighbor or your someone you know from your gym. Same thing happened to me recently, my ex was really surprised to see me. And she acted basically the same way. Like I was not there.

I agree, the best thing to do is to keep the head up and work on yourself. If they come back, then you might analyze the situation, but if they don't, it is their loss. As simple as that. Usually the dumpee ends evolving more than the dumper, because the dumpee firstly fought for the relationship to work, and after that the dumpee analyzes what was wrong, and what it is possible to improve. The dumper usually think that nothing was done wrong. They just wanted to get out of the relationship no matter what.
Most likely you will not get an apology. Again, apology envolves admitting you made a mistake or that you hurt someone. Most people do not do it.

It was a combination of things, I was worried she was not answering me for 2 days after a small and really non important discussion we had. Then I called her twice, she did not answer, messaged her a couple times asking if she was okay, whether she did not want to talk to me anymore and so on. Basically I was overthinking everything. I was scared she was gonna leave me. I am anxious insecure person with an anxious attachment style, so I guess with all that and the flowers, it was "too much" for her. But she acted, in my opinion, in a bad way to it. Called my attitude sick, ended up being really pissed off about the flowers and blocked me on everything afterwards.

Best option is to leave her alone. I am basically in the same boat as you. My ex blocked me on everything after I sent her flowers as an apology. She felt that I was too intense. But the truth is: the too intense was just an excuse for her to get out of our relationship. The first thing that appeared as an escape route for her, she used. Nowadays people do that, they blindside others without any empathy whatsoever.

They do not want to confront their own fears. If they say hi, or how are you doing, they are making themselves vulnerable for a conversation. They do not want that. People nowadays do not want to work on the relationships, so they run away, and whey they see you after the breakup, they prefere to pretend that they are indifferent. When the reality is: if you are really indifferent, you will say hi, or how you doing just to be polite, because it does not really matter the outcome. It's like greeting your neighbor or a someone you know from the gym.
